name: web-js-dom-lane
description: Read a value off a web page through the DOM with JavaScript instead of a recorded click (synthetic sample)

nodes.label: Launch Edge browser
nodes.idempotency_note: Only launches the browser and opens a read-only page; a rerun yields the same instance and the same page
nodes.reversibility_note: Launching the browser changes no remote state; closing the browser returns to the state before execution

nodes.label: Open the target page
nodes.idempotency_note: Navigating to the same URL is read-only; a rerun lands on the same page
nodes.reversibility_note: Navigation only loads the page and submits no data; going back or closing restores it

nodes.label: Read the page title through the DOM
nodes.idempotency_note: Only reads document.title and writes neither to the page nor to the remote side
nodes.reversibility_note: Reading the DOM changes nothing, so no rollback is needed

nodes.label: Close the browser
nodes.idempotency_note: Closing an already-open browser instance has no side effect when repeated
nodes.reversibility_note: Closing a local browser window changes no remote data
